d:
Jensen Huang, CEO of the American chip company Nvidia, has reportedly acknowledged a romantic relationship with Alice Huang. This development follows suspicions raised by U.S. intelligence agencies regarding a relationship between Jensen and Alice who has been accused of spying for China. Intelligence agencies suspect that she was working for a Chinese intelligence service. Jensen, currently the poster boy of the tech industry, has reportedly confirmed the relationship himself and offered an apology.
